name: The Ring Slide Pam
material: Soft, hand-selected Nigerian leather paired with a smooth solid brass statement ring. Cushioned sole with gently rounded edges and a steady, low heel.
care: Wipe with a soft dry cloth after wear. Rub in a little clear leather cream monthly to keep the straps soft. Polish the brass ring lightly with a dry cloth.
dimensions_weight: Weight: ~375g per pair. Low heel elevation: 12mm heel, 8mm forefoot.
description: A clean cut design with a statement ring. Modern, chic, and refined. You know those outfits where the clothes are simple but the footwear completely changes the look? That’s what we designed this for.
design_note: The smooth gold-toned ring rests gently across the front strap without pressing the top of your foot, lifting simple linen or denim effortlessly.
fit_notes: True to standard European size. The natural leather softens gently to match your foot width after 2–3 wears.
shipping_notes: Currently restocking in our Lagos workshop. Sign up on this page to be notified first when pairs return.

name: The Weave Slide Pam
material: Hand-braided straps in soft Nigerian leather, cushioned square-toe footbed, and flexible non-slip low sole.
care: Wipe clean with a soft dry cloth after wear. Store flat inside your cotton dust bag away from direct sunlight.
dimensions_weight: Weight: ~380g per pair. Sole thickness: 12mm heel, 8mm forefoot.
description: Braided leather straps for a textured finish. Stylish, refined, and timeless. Simple details, bigger impact. Effortlessly transforms everyday basics into an intentional, polished look.
design_note: Hand-braided straps move gently as you walk, spreading pressure evenly across your foot while adding warm texture to everyday outfits.
fit_notes: True to standard size. Woven leather provides gentle give to mirror foot contours.
shipping_notes: Crafted to order in 5 business days, followed by 2 business days for delivery. You will receive your order within 7 business days nationwide.

name: The Twist Slide Pam
material: Soft Nigerian leather with a gathered twist top strap, cushioned footbed with smooth finished edges, and a steady non-slip sole.
care: Wipe clean with a soft dry cloth after wear. Condition lightly once a month and store flat inside your cotton dust bag.
dimensions_weight: Weight: ~370g per pair. Low heel elevation: 12mm heel, 8mm forefoot.
description: A modern take on the classic pam, the Twist blends effortless comfort with a sculptural detail that sets it apart. Minimal, refined, and made to move with you.
design_note: The gathered leather twist bends comfortably with every step, lifting simple linen or denim with a clean, sculptural line.
fit_notes: True to standard European size. The natural leather softens gently to match your foot width after 2–3 wears.
